The '''Pylon Guardian''' was a type of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] created by the ''[[Gray Secant]]'', a [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] research [[Starship/Legends|starship]], for the purpose of guarding the research pylons that the ''Gray Secant'' would use to test [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] lifeforms. The large, three-legged [[Droid/Legends|droid]] came in two identical variations&mdash;Mk-II and the more powerful Mk-IV&mdash;and all Pylon Guardians were equipped with Gree [[disintegrator]]s, a digital [[Stasis field/Legends|stasis field]], and a phase pulse.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pylon Guardian appears as an enemy involved in the Heroic mission "Primary Testing" during the Relics of the Gree World Event on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]],<ref name="TOR" /> which was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.7: Return of the Gree on [[February 12]], [[2013]].<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/1.7.0/return-gree|text=Game Update 1.7: Return of the Gree Patch Notes}}</ref> Two variations appear: the Pylon Guardian Mk-IV, which can be found at the three pylons in the northern section of the [[Western Ice Shelf]], and the Pylon Guardian Mk-II, which is found in the open world player-vs-player zone in the center of the area. The Mk-II, like the Mk-II versions of the three other Gree droids involved in the mission, is reduced in strength to make it possible for smaller groups to complete the mission in an area where they can be attacked by other players.<ref name="TOR" />
